usage: Original faction emblems; runtime sizes are owned by tools.builders.build_adiscord_stp_regions_map.
shared_prompt: Create ONE square game UI faction emblem for a grounded retro-futurist grand strategy total conversion, A-Discord. {subject} Style: hand-painted 1940s strategy-game inventory icon, sculpted aged brass and muted silver, restrained dark plum enamel accent, tactile slightly worn metal, strong simple silhouette, sober institutional emblem, not a modern flat app logo. Central isolated emblem occupies 82% of square with clear margin. Front view, balanced readable composition, lit softly from upper left. Flat uniform opaque charcoal background RGB approximately 26,29,33, no environment. Designed to remain legible at 56 pixels. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no outer decorative frame, no nazi imagery, no excessive filigree, no neon, no photorealistic room. Output only this one emblem as a square image.

images.subject: CONSERVATIVES: a heavy bronze state seal showing three austere stone columns under a single lintel, a small closed laurel below. Established institutions and continuity.
BORONS, territorial power holders: a squat fortified keep with two towers, a single large antique key across its base. Local privileges and entrenched ownership.
SECURITY SERVICE: a watchful stylized silver eye inset in a dark bronze shield, one small keyhole beneath. Surveillance and guarded information.
ARMY COMMAND: two short crossed field marshal batons behind a heavy five-point military star, a restrained laurel base. Professional military command.
NODRUL FOREIGN ADVISERS: an eight-point northern compass star above a folded military map, a small pointing brass divider. Outside strategic guidance and northern influence.
MERCHANTS: compact bronze balance scales weighing two stacks of coins, a single sealed contract below. Trade and contracts.
RADICAL HEDONISTS: a wide ceremonial wine cup before a small radiant sun, a broken shackle at its foot. Pleasure, emancipation and rejection of old restrictions; dignified political emblem.
